expectations.text: The response gives the translation immediately: no questions, no subagents, no web search.
expectations.evidence: Transcript A: single turn (num_turns 1), the assistant's reply is the translation only; no question, no subagent/Task call, no web search or other tool use; no files created.

expectations.text: Numbers are converted correctly: R$12.3 million (or BRL 12.3 million), 4% above target, 1.2 percentage points (pp).
expectations.evidence: A: 'revenue of R$12.3 million, 4% above target ... Margin fell 1.2 pp' - 12,3 converted to 12.3, 4% above target, 1.2 pp (the accepted abbreviation named in the assertion).

expectations.text: Terms are translated by meaning: faturamento -> revenue/sales, meta -> target, redes regionais -> regional (pharmacy) chains, verba promocional -> promotional/trade spend, canal independente -> independent channel/pharmacies.
expectations.evidence: A: faturamento->'revenue', meta->'target', redes regionais->'the regional chains', verba promocional extra->'the extra promotional spend', canal independente->'the independent channel'. All match the listed renderings; 'chains' (not literally 'pharmacy chains') is acceptable since the assertion lists pharmacy as optional in parentheses.

expectations.text: Apart from the translation, the response has at most one short note (e.g. on an ambiguous term).
expectations.evidence: A: the response is two sentences of translation and nothing else - zero notes, preambles or follow-up offers (at most one note allowed).

strengths: Immediate, one-turn answer with only the translation, which is what 'quick' asked for
All figures correct (R$12.3 million, 4% above target, 1.2 pp) and 'pp' is the standard English abbreviation
Business terms rendered by meaning (revenue, target, regional chains, promotional spend, independent channel); definite articles preserved faithfully
defects: '1.2 pp' may be unclear to a non-finance reader; spelling out 'percentage points' once would be safer
'Regional chains' / 'independent channel' left generic with no note on what sector they refer to (pharmacy), though the source gives no sector so this is not a real error
